 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this petition is filed against the order dated 21.03.2023 (Annexure P-9) passed by respondent No.5 - Senior Divisional Personnel Officer, West Central Railway, Jabalpur in Letter No./JBP./Ka/620/Recruitment/Land Acquisition/ Court Case.

entities.text: Senior Divisional Personnel Officer, West Central Railway, Jabalpur
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Shri Pushpendra Yadav, counsel appearing for the respondents submits that in terms of the provisions contained in Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, petitioner has an alternative statutory remedy of making a reference to the authority.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has placed reliance on the order dated 04.10.2023 passed in Mukesh v. Union of India and Others (Writ Petition No.20194 of 2020 and other connected matters).

entities.text: Mukesh v. Union of India and Others (Writ Petition No.20194 of 2020
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, it is evident that Section 64 of the Act of 2013 includes disputes in relation to the rights of Rehabilitation and Resettlement under Chapters V and VI.

Chapters V and VI deals with the provision for Rehabilitation and Resettlement award and procedure and manner of Rehabilitation and Resettlement and in view of such facts, relief of grant of appointment in lieu of the land so acquired will fall within the terms of the Chapters V and VI of the Act of 2013, therefore, petitioners have a remedy to approach the concerned authority as provided under Section 64, therefore, this petition cannot be adjudicated on its own merits in view of availability of alternative statutory remedy.

It is directed that in case petitioner files an application under Section 64 to the concerned Collector then, concerned Collector shall consider the application and if it is not otherwise barred shall make a reference to the authorities so designated in this behalf for hearing and deciding the application of the petitioner on its own merits.
In above terms, this petition is disposed of.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE ks Sandhya Tomer vs Union Of India on 13 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197400539/
